legend: High-power view showing tumour cells with clear cytoplasm, crisp cytoplasmic membranes, and polygonal nuclei.
Overview showing the diffuse arrangement of pale cells interrupted by fibrovascular septa containing lymphocytes.
MRI showing a sellar germ cell tumour.
β-hCG staining highlights clusters of syncytiotrophoblast cells. The germinoma/dysgerminoma/seminoma tumour cells are negative.
OCT3/4 staining highlights the germinoma/dysgerminoma/seminoma tumour cells. The syncytiotrophoblast cells are negative.
Smear preparation with large tumour cells in a homogeneous and tigroid background.
This example shows admixed multinucleated syncytiotrophoblast cells.

T1-weighted sagittal MRI shows a poorly defined heterogeneous isointense to hypointense mass (extent marked by the two arrows) at the sellar and suprasellar region. Note the loss of the normal T1 bright spot of the posterior pituitary gland.
Contrast-enhanced T1-weighted sagittal MRI shows moderate enhancement of the tumour, the extent of which is shown by the two arrows.
